Name: Faster Grass
Author: asrdfsdvs
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size][size=2]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 2.0+.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Change the speed in the config file located in Stardew Valley/Mods/FasterGrass/config.json. (game default: 0, mod default: 3)
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/size]
[size=5]Extra info[/size]
[list]
[*]The grass grows through the night.
[*]Big numbers (50+) can make the grass spread to every free tile in the farm. Recommended(0 - 10).
[*]Should work with every mod.
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/FasterGrass.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: FasterGrass
Manifest.Description: Changes the grass growth speed based on the config.
Manifest.Author: IceGladiador
